note: Seeded from the production of the first four videos. Review each entry and delete or fix any that don't match your memory.

entries.where: RAG vs LLM Wiki video, head-to-head scene
entries.what: My script said RAG missed two of the questions. The recordings showed it answered both correctly.
entries.caught_by: Claude Code's check of the recordings before building the scene
entries.decision: Rewrote the narration to match the recordings instead of re-recording to fit the script.
entries.rule: Check every result line against the recordings before generating the avatar clip.

entries.what: The first test snapshot, drafted by my AI assistant, included lock-wait timeout errors that the fictional reports say can't happen, and a date in the future.
entries.caught_by: Claude's own answer in the off-camera run
entries.decision: Fixed the snapshot and ran it again before recording.
entries.rule: Do an off-camera run first, and fix the test data, never the prompt.

entries.what: The narration named the months of two incidents, but the recording only showed report IDs.
entries.decision: Added on-screen callouts labeled 'from the wiki'.
entries.rule: If the narration claims it, the screen must show it.

entries.what: The demo rated the incident P1. I would have rated it P2.
entries.decision: Kept the disagreement in the video.

entries.where: Mission Control video, first demo run
entries.what: The first demo ran in a folder whose instructions were written for video production, not for the demo.
entries.caught_by: My AI assistant, reviewing the recording
entries.decision: Built a clean workspace with only the instructions shown on screen.
entries.rule: Demos run in a workspace that holds nothing the viewer can't see.

entries.what: Note cards showed invented meeting names and dates in a scene about my real meetings.
entries.caught_by: My AI assistant, reviewing the render
entries.decision: Replaced them with generic labels and no dates.
entries.rule: Don't invent details about real things.

entries.what: The script put a paraphrase of a transcript line inside quote marks.
The first thumbnail read like an operations ticket and didn't speak to managers.
entries.caught_by: Me, asking whether it would reach our audience
entries.decision: Rewrote the text around the manager's problem.
entries.rule: The thumbnail names the audience's problem, not the system's wording.

entries.what: The logo I made for the fictional company used a name that a real software organization already uses.
entries.caught_by: My AI assistant, with a web search
entries.rule: Search a fictional name before putting it on screen.

entries.what: My spec's test assumed the alert-hygiene sprint ask was still open. The notes show it closed on Sep 22.
entries.caught_by: Claude Code, before it built anything
entries.rule: The site shows the latest status word for word and never decides what is closed.

entries.what: The first table listed 30 suggested items alongside 36 things people actually said.
entries.caught_by: My AI assistant, reviewing the page
entries.decision: Hid suggested items by default and added an owner filter.
entries.rule: Keep what was said and what was suggested apart by default.

entries.what: The same promise appeared twice with two different statuses.
entries.caught_by: My AI assistant, reviewing the page
entries.decision: Left both rows and did not let the site guess.
entries.rule: Fix duplicates at the source, not by guessing in the tool.

entries.what: One summary labelled a coaching point "Coaching opportunity", so the agent would have skipped it.
entries.caught_by: Claude Code, after creating the agent
entries.decision: The agent reads both labels, and the instructions now fix the labels.
entries.rule: Coaching points always use the same two labels.

entries.what: The summary put a paraphrase in quote marks: "add your name". Nobody said those words.
entries.caught_by: My AI assistant, checking quotes against the transcript
entries.decision: Kept the summary and won't quote that line.
entries.rule: Quote marks are for exact words only.

entries.what: Claude widened my request when it started the agent, so the agent read transcripts, my Carnegie notes and the board, all outside its Sources.
entries.caught_by: My AI assistant, checking the answer against the files. Claude Code confirmed the cause.
entries.decision: Added a rule to each agent, and told Claude to pass my requests on unchanged.
entries.rule: A Sources line is only a description until a rule enforces it.

entries.what: Claude rewrote the agent's page with its own headings, so I couldn't see whether my format was followed.
entries.decision: Told Claude to show the agent's answer unchanged.
entries.rule: Review what the agent wrote, not a summary of it.

entries.what: Its answer named a detail from a Manager-only note while telling me to keep those notes private.
entries.caught_by: My AI assistant, reading the answer
entries.decision: Added a rule to both agents and blurred the line in the video.
entries.rule: Private notes stay out of every answer, including warnings about them.
